title: Business Process Analyst (f/m/d)
description:
Support our transformation programme by analysing and redesigning operational processes.

What you'll do
- Document current processes and identify improvement potential
- Work with business units on target processes
- Prepare management decisions

What you bring
- A degree in business, information systems or a related field and experience in documenting, analysing and redesigning processes with BPMN, interviewing business owners and process participants, measuring cycle times and error rates with SQL or Excel, running improvement workshops, and presenting recommendations to senior managers in English
- Good command of English
